summary: Comprehensive frontend testing of the redesigned Backup Management page with isometric datacenter room cards. All 12 test cases passed (100%). The page successfully matches the Clara isometric 3D style used in the Server Rack view.

issues: Console warnings about missing DialogTitle and aria-describedby for DialogContent - accessibility improvement needed (not blocking)

critical_code_review_comments: The BackupManagementPage.js is well-structured with proper component separation (BackupSiteCard, BackupDetailPanel)
All interactive elements have proper data-testid attributes for testing
The page correctly uses environment variables for API URL (process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL)
Minor: Consider adding DialogTitle to login wizard modal for accessibility compliance
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backup Management page at /backups is fully functional with isometric card-based UI. All features tested: card display, environment grouping, detail panel with backup operations (create, restore, delete, clone), close functionality, stats display. The page uses h-screen for full viewport height and matches the Server Rack view style.

test_cases_executed.description: Backup page loads at /backups route after login
Isometric site cards are displayed (data-testid starts with 'backup-card-')
Sites are grouped by environment with environment labels visible
test_cases_executed.details: Found Production, Staging, Yannick environment labels

test_cases_executed.description: Each card shows site name, type badge, backup count badge, and last backup time
Clicking a card opens the backup detail panel (data-testid='backup-detail-panel')
Detail panel shows site name, backup count, total size
Detail panel has 'Nieuwe Backup' and 'Clone' buttons
Detail panel lists backups with status icons, type labels (Handmatig/Automatisch), dates, doc counts, sizes
Each backup row has restore and delete action buttons
Clicking close button (data-testid='backup-panel-close') closes the detail panel
Top bar shows total site count and total backup/environment stats
Bottom bar shows 'Backup systeem actief' status

design_review.text_contrast: GOOD - Cards use zinc-800 text on white/light backgrounds
design_review.spacing: GOOD - Cards have proper padding (px-3.5 py-3)
design_review.footer: GOOD - Bottom status bar properly positioned
design_review.isometric_style: GOOD - Cards match Clara 3D style with room images and radial gradient masks
